meta.title: Live-auction audience addition requires view access

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer removes the invited vendor from the live round with 1 audience to remove uuids.
The buyer sends the request that invites vendors to a round, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
